response.rationale: R3 best integrates the full invasive pattern: bilateral sinus opacification, left intraorbital enhancement, and extension into the cavernous sinus with pachymeningeal enhancement, in a chronically immunosuppressed patient on high-dose prednisone. R2 accounts only for the cavernous sinus complication and not the sinonasal/orbital distribution. R6 covers only the orbital component, R5 only the sinonasal component, R7 only the painful cavernous/pachymeningeal syndrome, and R1 is limited to a single intraorbital span. C1 is a correlated restatement of R3 adding only an acute temporal modifier, so it is discounted.

rejected.why: Correlated restatement of R3 with only an acute temporal modifier; no independent raw support.

Explains sinonasal findings but not orbital or cavernous extension; lacks the invasive extrasinus pattern.
Explains painful ophthalmoplegia and pachymeningeal enhancement but not sinus opacification or intraorbital involvement.
